principle: The corpus has ONE inclusion scope: inclusion-by-default (CLAUDE.md Part 1; docs/conventions; memory project_ingest_scope_pathway_dimension). Lane-specific tools (e.g. FRANK's retail-occurrence gap-fetcher) may RANK or deprioritize papers differently, but they MUST NOT hard-exclude (denylist) anything in the corpus in-scope set. Deprioritization is fine; silent exclusion falsifies the 'we have reviewed the complete literature' claim the whole HMI thesis rests on. THE INVARIANT: a denylist keyword that matches an in_scope category is a build-blocking contradiction.
documented_scope_sources: CLAUDE.md Part 13 (evidence grading — systematic reviews are A-tier)
2026-06-18 decision (Karen): remediation / phytoremediation literature is in-scope

remediation.description: Field remediation of soil/cropland and the recovery technologies built on the same biology. NOT food-as-adsorbent water treatment (see out_of_scope.adsorption_water_treatment).

soil_to_plant_transfer.description: Upstream soil->plant uptake mechanism the soil-to-plant-transfer hub is built to hold.

exposure_assessment.description: Dietary and human exposure-assessment science (exposure lane).

microbiome.description: Microbiome material touching the metals domain (federates to WikiBiome). NOTE: bare 'rhizosphere' is intentionally NOT listed here — it is dual-use (microbiome vs molecular-biology) and lives in ambiguous.

reviews_syntheses.description: Systematic reviews, meta-analyses, and narrative reviews are evidence (A/B-tier per Part 13), not noise.

marine_aquatic_bioaccumulation.description: Bioaccumulation/biomagnification into aquatic food webs (marine lane).

source_attribution.description: Source apportionment / provenance / environmental-burden attribution (attribution lane).

sensors.description: Analytical sensor/biosensor methodology papers — not occurrence or mechanism.

materials_science.description: Materials-science synthesis where the metal is an engineering input.

plant_molecular_biology.description: Gene-level lab plant biology (not field uptake/occurrence). 'rhizosphere' deliberately omitted -> ambiguous.

amr_microbiology.description: Antimicrobial-resistance / lab microbiology not about food-metal occurrence.

clinical_case_reports.description: Clinical case reports / disease epidemiology, not food occurrence.

toxicology_mechanism_protective.description: Protective-effect / oxidative-stress mechanism papers, not occurrence.

adsorption_water_treatment.description: Food/biomass used as an adsorbent for water/effluent treatment — NOT food occurrence and NOT soil/crop remediation. (Distinct from in_scope.remediation.)

ecology_non_food.description: Pure ecology / bioindicator studies, not food.

veterinary_wildlife.description: Veterinary / wildlife / aquaculture-environment, not retail food.

animal_experiment_only.description: Animal-feeding experiments, not retail food occurrence.

ambiguous._note: Currently denylisted but NOT clearly out-of-scope under the documented lanes. The lint treats these as DECLARED (no build failure), but they are surfaced here for Karen's scope decision. recommendation = Claude's lean; needs_decision = true until Karen rules.

human_biomonitoring.description: Human blood/urine/hair biomonitoring — exposure/tox-adjacent (lane leans in-scope) but not a food matrix (food-occurrence focus leans out).
human_biomonitoring.recommendation: lean in-scope (tox/exposure lane) but keep deprioritized in the retail-occurrence fetch lane

environmental_water_sediment.description: Drinking/surface/ground water and sediment compartments. Drinking-water-for-consumption can be in-scope; environmental water-quality / sediment-only studies usually not.
environmental_water_sediment.recommendation: keep denylisted for the retail-occurrence fetch lane; revisit bottled/drinking water for consumption separately

occupational_air_industrial.description: Occupational/air exposure routes and industrial point sources. Atmospheric DEPOSITION onto cropland is in_scope; ambient air pollution / occupational exposure is a different route.
occupational_air_industrial.recommendation: mostly out, but 'sewage sludge' and 'atmospheric' inputs to cropland blur into exposure lane — review

dual_use_terms.description: Single keywords that are in-scope in one sense and out in another; too blunt to denylist safely.
dual_use_terms.recommendation: rhizosphere -> lean in-scope (microbiome); biochar -> lean in-scope (soil amendment, per agronomic mitigation + chen2020/patil2022 ingests). Replace blunt keyword with phrase-level patterns rather than denylisting the bare word.
